The business has undergone a structural turnaround in its top line, demonstrating robust compounded sales growth of 30% over 5 years [E15] alongside positive recent momentum with sales up 5% year-on-year [E67]. This fundamental improvement is starting to be reflected in the company's performance, as profit growth exceeds 1-year price growth by 59%, indicating the company is starting to outperform expectations [E55]. Jet Solar Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, evidenced by a price-to-book ratio of 0.45x [E2] and 0.43x against a sector benchmark of 1.48x [E7]. While long-term metrics have been challenging, the company has demonstrated a clear structural turnaround with 30% compounded sales growth and 16% compounded profit growth over the last five years [E15, E19]. This momentum is further supported by recent data showing 5% year-over-year sales growth [E67]. The market is currently mispricing this recovery, as evidenced by the fact that profit growth recently exceeded one-year price growth by 59%, signaling that the company is beginning to outperform expectations [E55]. Conceded: [E1], [E4], [E5], [E6], [E8], [E14], [E18], [E20], [E21], [E70]. The stock is currently sitting at the bottom of its 52-week range [E5], offering a compelling entry point for those recognizing the shift toward fundamental outperformance [E55].
